annotations.text: Top row: the three round-2 directions. YOUR PICK — Ledger + Index combined — lives in the second row as two states of one design. Shared DNA everywhere: tinted white paper, vertical-panel navigation, roman serif display, one quiet accent under 5% of the screen. Accent colors remain provisional until the palette pass.

THE MANUSCRIPT — Newsreader + Plex Mono, sienna accent.
Healy/arungc energy: a typeset document with a slim rail as the only chrome. Kept for reference; not the chosen direction.

THE LEDGER — EB Garamond + Plex Sans, viridian accent.
Permanent identity panel; the right pane swaps content in place. LIST/WHEEL toggle is where the Paper Wheel lives. One of your two picks — its landing seriousness feeds the hybrid.

THE INDEX — Instrument Serif + Geist, ultramarine accent.
The viewport is the menu: uneven panels, hover tints + preview rises, click expands. Your other pick — its navigation behavior feeds the hybrid.

THE HYBRID — your direction. Instrument Serif + Geist.
LANDING (left): the identity panel gives a serious first impression; Research / Practice / Lab sit beside it as live panels with previews — Index energy without losing gravitas.
NAVIGATION (right): click Research → identity compresses to a rail, the section expands, others become slivers. Panel widths spring (interruptible, slight settle); content crossfades in ~220ms after the geometry lands. Back arrow or ESC restores the landing.
Inside Research: LIST/WHEEL toggle — the Wheel is the default view, focal card unfolds to the left with takeaway + key figure.
Mobile: panels stack as full-width rows; the wheel degrades to a list.
THE PAPER WHEEL storyboard — the interaction inside the hybrid's Research panel (shown in context in the Research-open artboard).

THE LAB — card carousel, adapted from your reference screenshot into our system: cover image on top (original SVG art in the Atlas palette — the reference's illustration belongs to its own designer), mono eyebrow, serif title, short description, ONE marigold-banded key line (focal card only), attribution, and OPEN → linking to the live deliverable (hosted wherever — external or on the site). Arrows + numbered pagination (active number in red). Prev/next cards peek from the edges and spring across on navigation.
All three artifacts are still placeholders; the '42 proposals' line is real (your SIL tournament). Also in this update: your REAL photo (landing, rail, About) and your REAL CV data (positions, education from cv.pdf). Confirm one thing: the CV says 'Ph.D. Candidate 2018–2024' — the About board says 'Ph.D., Economics' assuming you finished. Correct?

THE MISSING STATES — designed after your round of decisions:
PHOTO: portrait in the identity panel (placeholder frame until you pick the shot), repeated small at the top of the compressed rail on every open section.
ABOUT & CV: photo + contact block left; bio + WEB CV right — positions and education rendered from a cv.yml file you edit, always current, with the PDF as the long-form download. [TO CONFIRM] tags mark fields awaiting your real data.
PRACTICE, redefined: two streams — CASE STUDIES (expanded entry pattern, can link into Lab artifacts) and ESSAYS (dated list). All titles here are illustrative placeholders for you to replace or veto.
COLOPHON: every scrolling pane ends with email · Scholar · GitHub · CV + an UPDATED stamp. No global footer chrome; contact always lives in the identity panel/rail.

PALETTE — SETTLED: ATLAS COOLED + MARIGOLD BAND.
Paper #FAFBFC · panel #EEF1F4 · ink #0E2E42 (no black) · hairlines #DFE4E8 · BRICK RED #C1121F interactive only · STEEL #669BBC data only · oxblood #780000 pressed states · MARIGOLD #FFE38F as the highlighter-band device (behind one key phrase per screen, x-height band, never text color, never a fill).
See the band live on both hybrid boards: 'this site is the bridge' (landing) and 'who actually pays?' (research).
The Viridian studies to the right are retired runners-up, kept for the record. Full rules codified in DESIGN.md in the repo.
